standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit 2-fibre product model
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the fibre product T_2 = S_2 x_{S_1} T_1 and the morphism sets used to read off Aut(y').

core_obligations: Note T_1 is already a stack in groupoids by hypothesis; only triviality of the automorphism sheaves needs proof.
Replace U by members of a covering so that, by (2), there is x in (S_2)_U and an isomorphism f : F(x) -> G(y); then y' = (U, x, y, f) is an object of T_2 over U mapping to y.
Use full faithfulness of F to read the explicit morphism description of the fibre product: Aut(y') -> Aut(y) is surjective.
Conclude Aut(y) is trivial because Aut(y') is trivial by (3).
proof_roadmap: Localize to lift y to an object y' of T_2, transport the surjection Aut(y') -> Aut(y) from full faithfulness, and conclude by triviality of Aut(y').
difficulty_reason: Single strategy (lift, transport automorphisms, conclude triviality) with the transport step a direct reading of the explicit fibre-product description.
